description: This Java source file defines the SerialPort class within the jssc package. It provides functionalities for serial port communication, including opening, closing, configuring parameters, reading, writing, and managing port events. The class interfaces with native system calls through SerialNativeInterface and handles various serial port operations and events, including support for different operating systems (Linux, Solaris, macOS). It also includes methods for setting flow control, managing line status, and asynchronous event handling via listener pattern.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Represents a serial port, providing methods for communication, configuration, event handling, and line status monitoring.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the port name currently in use by the instance.

methods.name: isOpened
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens the serial port for communication, throwing exceptions if port is busy or not found.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures serial port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity, with optional RTS/DTR control.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges input and/or output buffers based on provided flags.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets the event mask to specify which serial port events to listen for.

methods.name: getEventsMask
methods.description: Retrieves the current event mask for the port.

methods.name: setRTS
methods.description: Sets the RTS line state.

methods.name: setDTR
methods.description: Sets the DTR line state.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the serial port.

methods.name: writeByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the serial port.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Sends a String over the serial port with default charset.

methods.name: writeString (with charsetName)
methods.description: Sends a String over the serial port using specified charset.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Writes a single integer (byte value) to the port.

methods.name: writeIntArray
methods.description: Writes an array of integers (bytes) to the port.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the port.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads bytes from the port and returns as String.

methods.name: readHexString
methods.description: Reads bytes from the port and returns as Hex String with space separator.

methods.name: readHexString (with separator)
methods.description: Reads bytes from the port and returns as Hex String with specified separator.

methods.name: readHexStringArray
methods.description: Reads bytes and returns an array of Hex String representations.

methods.name: readIntArray
methods.description: Reads bytes and returns as array of integers (0-255).

methods.name: getInputBufferBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available in the input buffer.

methods.name: getOutputBufferBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes in the output buffer.

methods.name: setFlowControlMode
methods.description: Configures flow control mode using predefined constants.

methods.name: getFlowControlMode
methods.description: Returns the current flow control setting.

methods.name: sendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal for the specified duration.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for serial port events, with options for event mask and overwrite.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Removes the previously added event listener.

methods.name: closePort
methods.description: Closes the serial port, releasing resources and removing event listeners.
